plan.title: Technical Quick Fill Same as Requested

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create a Technical Stage event, which is the subject of the test.
Move to the technical stage before configuring its questionnaire.
Apply the first available technical questionnaire template.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Populate the buyer-specified questionnaire values that the vendor should copy.
Invite the QA vendor who will perform Quick Fill.
Publish the event so it is available in the vendor portal.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor session.
Open the event directly on its Technical Stage questionnaire.
Open the vendor's Quick Fill options.
Choose the option that should copy the buyer's requested values into the responses.
Confirm the copy action completed without an application error, while acknowledging that exact dynamic field equality is not directly observable by the catalog.
